scope: First parametric 3D Copilot workflow: four-hole mounting plate and selected-solid length edits

fullNodeRegression.note: Run includes the first five new solid tests. A sixth test for existing linked extrusion editing was added afterward and passed in the targeted run.

warnings: Vite reports a main chunk larger than 500 kB

numericOracles.stepRoundtrip: Node exports the edited 100x50x4 plate, reads the bytes with STEPControl_Reader, checks BRep validity, bbox and analytic volume. Same kernel roundtrip, not independent-kernel validation. Browser separately exports the final 100x50x6 plate.

observedFailuresAndRepairs: Browser exposed missing solid contract prop forwarding through ExplorerPanel; repaired and retested.
Browser test report overlay obscured input and active Model tree toggling hid its selection target; test placement/navigation repaired.
copilotEdit regression reached 23 checks then timed out during concurrent full Node/browser runs; isolated rerun passed all 25 checks without a production change.
limits: Local rule recipe supports four circular through holes with equal edge margins, not arbitrary natural-language CAD.
Gateway uses a fixture for contract testing; no live model provider/authentication was connected.
One advertised length dimension per selected-solid edit; expressions, angles, unrelated shared variables and mixed editing batches are outside this scope.
No new external package or copied third-party implementation was introduced.
